description: All-in-one ECOSYSTEM briefing: market regime, active signals, anomalies, health matrix, sports calendar, and whale activity in one response. Use instead of calling 6+ tools sequentially. USE THIS for a market-wide overview. USE tokenintel_token_context for a SINGLE-TOKEN deep dive (price, signals, health, whale flow, sports catalyst, news — all for one symbol). Returns data, not recommendations -- interpret results yourself.

focus.description: Optional token symbol to focus on (e.g., 'BAR'). Omit for full ecosystem view.

timeframe.description: Briefing depth: 'morning' (24h window, default) or 'weekly' (7-day trends).
